main_text.l: בלו m. Tributum provinciale, Vetus & solitum, Esr.4: v.13. Talmudici exponunt כסף גולגלתא [?] Tributum capitationis, in singula capita.

בלג Hiph. הִבְלִיג Recreare, Confortare se. Præt. הִבְלִיג Qui recreat se, Amos 5.9. Fœm. cum paragogico, מִבְלִיגִית Recreans, vel recreatura se, scil. anima, Jer.8.18. Juxta quosdam est Nomen, Recreatio mea. Futur. וַאֲבַלִּיגֵהוּ [?] Et recreabo me, Job.9.27. & ib. v.20. Psal.39.14.

בלה Veterascere, Vetustate teri, Atteri, Deteri: Præter. וְלֹא־בָלוּ Non inveterarunt, Deuter. 29.5. Infin. אַחֲרֵי בִלְתִּי Post veterascere me, Genes.18.12. Pih. בִּלָּה Consumpsit, Trivit, Detrivit: Præterit. בִּלָּה בְשָׂרִי Terit carnem meam, Thren.3.4. Partic. מְבַלִּהִים vide in בהל. Infinit. לְבַלּוֹת Consumendo, Psalm.49.15. Futur. יְבַלּוּ Deterent, Jesa.65.22.
בָּלָה m. Vetus, Tritum: Plural. שַׂקִּים בָּלִים Saccos tritos, Josh.9.4. Fœm. בְּלָה Effata, Ezech.23.43. Plural. נְעָלוֹת בְּלוֹת Calcei triti, Josh.9.5.
בְּלוִּים m.p. Veteramenta: Constr. בְּלוֵי Jerem.38.11. & בְּלוּאֵי v.12.
בַּלֵּהָה [?] f. Vide supra in בהל.

בלל בָּלַל Confudit, Perfudit, Miscuit, Genes.11.9. בֻּלְּתִי Perfudi, Psalm.92.11. vel intransitivè, Perfusus sum. R.Sal. Infinitivum facit cum Affixo, pro לִבְלּוֹתִי Perfundendo me, hoc est, juxta Chaldaum, רַבִּיתָא יָתִי Inunge me oleo recenti, id est, constanti dominatu, viribus & potentiâ me instruis, ut non peream (sicut improbi, quorum infa-bilitatem versu precedenti propofuit. Similem formam Infinitivi vide in חָנַן. Quidam faciunt Infinitum Pihel à בלה.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are approximate where marked [?]. The Chaldaic phrase in the בלל entry and the Hebrew in the בלה entry are uncertain. The word "infa-" at the line end is doubtful (possibly "insta-"). The catchword is the Hebrew word at the bottom right.
